title: Understanding the Objective Function
text: The objective function $R(\theta)=1/1000*sum_{i\=1}{3}{abs(x_i-\theta)}$ involves the absolute differences between each data point and $\theta$. Think about what value of $\theta$ would make these differences as small as possible.

title: Median as a Minimizer
text: For a set of numbers, the median minimizes the sum of absolute deviations. Consider how this might apply to the data points {1, $$6$$, 17}.

title: Choosing the Right $\theta$
text: Which value of $\theta$ minimizes the sum of absolute deviations for the data points {1, $$6$$, 17}?
